caption:
How to get the best deal when withdrawing cash from a foreign bank account in Japan 

#japantrip #japanlife #japanvacation #japantraveltips #japantravel #japanguide #7eleven #konbini".
transcription: Don't make this mistake when taking cash out in Japan. I always go to 7.11 but when you withdraw you get two options for conversion. If I choose pounds, the ATM adds a conversion fee, supposedly only 4%. For example, instead of paying 283 pound 50 here based on the basic exchange rate, I ended up paying 297 pounds 7 pence. When I worked it out, the fee they'd added on was actually closer to 4.8%. Now, if I choose yen, my bank handles the conversion, and instead of paying 53 pounds in the second example, I paid 54 pounds 48 pounds, so a fee of about 2.8%. So it's never completely free, but choosing yen should get you a better deal, at least with styling because they don't add big exchange fees. Some banks might charge more though, so it depends. Also, I found this on the 7 bank site, with drawing outside of regular hours might add another small fee so try not to wake the ATM up from it's sleep.
